title: Compliance Note: Servicemember Rate Cap Terms for Retail Installment Contracts
content:
Under the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act (50 U.S.C. 3937), a contract under Retail Installment Contracts incurred before military service carries a maximum interest rate during that service. The company's terms are the same at every tier.

| Tier | Maximum rate during military service | Days after the end of military service within which the written request must be received |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 6.0% | 180 |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 6.0% | 180 |
| Tier 4 Standard | 6.0% | 180 |
| Tier 3 Advantage | 6.0% | 180 |
| Tier 2 Preferred | 6.0% | 180 |
| Tier 1 Select | 6.0% | 180 |

The request window is counted in calendar days.

**Reading the cap (hypothetical rates).** A contract at 23.49% is reduced to 6.0% while the cap applies. A contract already carrying 5.75% is at or below 6.0% and its rate is not changed.
